lists.name: Menos celular y redes

Me desconecto para reconectar.

Mi mente descansa.

Saboreo mi comida.

lists.name: Less phone and social media
phrases: I am the one who controls my phone, not the other way around.
I use my phone with intention.
My attention is worth more than any notification.
I choose where to put my attention.
I put the phone down and look around me.
There is a real world waiting for me.
Life is outside the screen.

I don't have to reply instantly.
Nothing is as urgent as it seems.
The phone is not an extension of my hand.
I can be without it for a while and be fine.
I go for a walk without my phone.
I leave the phone in another room while I work.
I keep the phone out of the bedroom.
I don't fall asleep with a screen in my hand.

I don't start the day with social media.
I start the day breathing, stretching, giving thanks.
My morning begins in calm.
My night ends in calm.

I respect the limit I set.
When the alert comes, I close the app.

I stop following what makes me feel bad.

"Likes" don't measure what I'm worth.
I stop comparing my life to what others show.
What I see on social media is a small, edited part.
My real life is enough.
I prefer one real conversation to a hundred messages.
I call someone I love.
I make plans in person.
I hug, laugh and share without screens.
I read a book instead of scrolling.
I write in a notebook.
I draw, cook, walk, play.
I get bored without guilt; boredom awakens my creativity.
I let my mind wander.
My best ideas come when I'm not looking at the phone.
My mind clears with less stimulation.
My concentration improves every day.
I can work for an hour without looking at my phone.
I can eat without a screen.
I can wait without taking out my phone.
I can be in silence.
I enjoy stillness.
I notice the urge to check and let it pass.
The urge rises and falls, like a wave.
I breathe before picking up the phone.
I ask myself: what am I picking it up for?
I use the phone for what I want, and then I put it down.
I choose content that inspires me.
I choose to learn, not just to be distracted.
I make use of technology wisely.
Technology serves me.
I disconnect in order to reconnect.
One day a week I disconnect for a while.
A weekend without social media renews me.
I feel lighter without so many notifications.
I feel freer when I'm the one who decides.
My time belongs to me.
I recover valuable hours of my life.
Every minute counts.
I prefer to invest my time in what I love.
My body is grateful for less screen time.
My eyes rest.
My neck and back relax.
My mind rests.
My sleep improves.
My mood improves.
I feel more present and more alive.
I notice the beauty of the sky, the trees, the people.
I listen to the sounds around me.
I savor my food.
I smile at those I pass.
I am here.
Today I choose less screen and more life.
I am winning my attention back.
I am building a healthy relationship with technology.
I congratulate myself for every small step forward.
It's not all or nothing; I move forward step by step.
If I slip, I start again without judging myself.
I am stronger than a habit.
I can change my habits.
My freedom is my greatest gain.
Today I take control.
